title: On Lie Algebras with Only Inner Derivations
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of non-semisimple Lie algebras of the form $\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{S} \ltimes \mathcal{N}$ whose derivations are all inner. By generalizing the methods of Sato and Angelopoulos, we introduce new families of Lie algebras and establish the vanishing of their first adjoint cohomology. As an application, we construct a family of complete non-perfect Lie algebras, thereby providing examples that yield a positive answer to Carles' question on the existence of such algebras.
